name: Knack for Creativity
portrait_alt: Kimberly Castillo holding a film camera up to her face
statement: I'm Kimberly, a photographer and creative based in Dallas, Texas. Through a documentary approach and an editorial eye, I create photographs that preserve life's most meaningful moments, from wedding veils and graduation caps to worship nights and quiet celebrations. Every story deserves to be remembered beautifully.
contact_text: Tell me your date, your venue, and what matters most. I reply to every inquiry personally.
